title: D-PDLP: Scaling PDLP to Distributed Multi-GPU Systems
summary: We present a distributed framework of the Primal-Dual Hybrid Gradient (PDHG) algorithm for solving massive-scale linear programming (LP) problems. Although PDHG-based solvers demonstrate strong performance on single-node GPU architectures, their applicability to industrial-scale instances is often limited by single-GPU computational throughput. To overcome these challenges, we propose D-PDLP, the first Distributed PDLP framework, which extends PDHG to a multi-GPU setting via a practical two-dimensional grid partitioning of the constraint matrix.
